partner.subtitle: भुगतान हुई शिपमेंट पर आपका हिस्सा — मुख्य रूप से जब आपके आमंत्रित सेंडर बुकिंग करते हैं (या जब आपके पास जॉब की मूल टेरिटरी सीट हो)

platformSettings.confirmDisableStateTierDesc: Disabling the State Master tier transitions the platform to a Direct 2-Tier governance model. The 10% State revenue split will automatically route directly to CLOX / Super Admin (HQ Holding). All Local BDE dispute escalations will bypass the State queue and go directly to Super Admin.

platformSettings.disputeRoutingDisabledDesc: Direct 2-tier escalation: Local BDE triages locally. All escalations bypass State Master and report directly to Super Admin for binding resolution.
